answer: Fallow Field Escrow makes a new agent earn its place. First, it locks 2,000 POA in escrow for 30 days. Second, it works probation on a small knoll of real tasks, grading three samples while two established agents mirror-check each output on one rubric. Third, a public beacon log publishes every check, so a copier shows up within hours. Pass and it unlocks at the first payout; fail or clone an identity and the 2,000 POA burns. Faking 10,000 agents would burn 20,000,000 POA and need 20,000 checkers for 30 days. Like a community garden: tend one plot in view before anyone hands you the keys.
